listing.name: Starsector Audio Fixer
listing.summary: A small patch that addresses an issue that has existed in the game for ages.
listing.aiSummary: Fixes audio loss when the system's default audio device changes during gameplay.

description: Upgrades OpenAL and uses a proxy to handle Windows audio device swaps. This prevents the game from losing sound if headphones disconnect or speakers change, eliminating the need to restart.
